where.if: AND complaint_title LIKE CONCAT(#{keyword},'%') OR emp_name LIKE CONCAT(#{keyword},'%')

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sgtransit_complaint ( emp_no, emp_id, emp_name, emp_phone, complaint_category, complaint_title, complaint_content, complaint_password, complaint_status, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{empNo}, #{empId}, #{empName}, #{empPhone}, #{category}, #{title}, #{content}, #{password}, #{status}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE sgtransit_complaint SET complaint_status=#{status}, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE complaint_no=#{complaintNo}

UPDATE sgtransit_complaint SET complaint_category=#{category}, complaint_title=#{title}, complaint_content=#{content}, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE complaint_no=#{complaintNo} AND emp_no=#{empNo} AND complaint_status='CHECKING'

UPDATE sgtransit_complaint SET emp_id='retained-record', emp_name='민원인', emp_phone='', updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE complaint_status='COMPLETED' AND updated_at < #{cutoff} AND emp_name <> '민원인' ORDER BY complaint_no LIMIT #{limit}
